messages:
maya: Quick flag before the KPI sync: our weekly dashboard shows a sudden drop in webinar-to-MQL rate for May. Link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/marketing/kpi-weekly (see webinar card) :mag:
tony: can you confirm the cohort filter you used? dashboards sometimes default to 7d vs our KPI 30d window
maya: cohort = webinar_may_2024 (created 2024-05-01..2024-05-07). shows 1,980 leads, 95 MQLs -> 4.8%
rachel: benchmark narrative expected ~8% after nurture. wondering if attribution change or routing impacted MQL tagging
revops-bot: Alert: inbound-router v2.4 deployed 2024-05-08T03:10Z by infra (rule: score<0.15 -> low_priority)
sam: that deploy may have routed most webinar leads to low_priority; mql enrichment only runs for primary route
maya: can someone run a quick query to check route distribution for that utm_campaign?
infra: quick SQL: SELECT route, COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE utm_campaign='webinar-may' AND created_at >= '2024-05-01' GROUP BY route; -> primary=480, low_priority=1,500
ton y: ok that explains it. routing change, not creative performance. we should note this in the KPI deck and benchmark doc
rachel: action items: 1) temporary backfill for webinar leads so mql_enrichment runs (infra) 2) whitelist webinar utm in router rules (infra + revops) 3) update benchmark narrative and KPI card copy (rachel) 4) retrain scoring model to include webinar signals (sam)
infra: opened PR INFRA-867 "whitelist webinar utm in inbound-router". staging revert queued, ETA ~90m
maya: I'll update the KPI slide: "May webinar MQL dip due to inbound routing change; mitigation in progress (INFRA-867)." will cover this in the sync today :white_check_mark:
revops-bot: PR merged to staging 2024-05-08T05:00Z
sam: after backfill please ping me to re-run the cohort metrics and update the weekly card
rachel: added note to benchmark doc and flagged owners. will circulate updated slide before the review
maya: thanks team, good catch. we'll monitor next reporting window to confirm recovery :chart_with_upwards_trend:
